# API.md — every endpoint (generated by scripts/gen_api_docs.py — do not edit)

One Vercel function (`api/index.py`). Public reads fall back to the committed JSON; every `/api/os/*` write is audited and needs an officer session (Supabase JWT, or `X-Local-Role` off Vercel). Admin-only: board writes, terms/rollover, site-settings, inbox replay.

## Shapes

Request bodies are the pydantic models in `api/_core/models.py`; the TypeScript twins are generated into `apps/web/src/lib/api.types.ts` by `scripts/gen_types.py`. Public read responses keep the shape of their `data/*.json` fallback.
